title: Sync Manifest
description: Record of a sync operation between this repo and a source framework repo or style pack. Lists every item that was applied, skipped, or conflicted. No silent overwrites — every change is traceable through this manifest.

manifest_id.description: Unique identifier for this sync operation

sync_direction.description: Direction of the sync: import=source→local, export=local→source, bidirectional=both

source.description: Path or identifier of the source repo or pack

target.description: Path or identifier of the target repo (defaults to current repo if not specified)

scope.description: Categories included in this sync scope (e.g. 'doctrine', 'style-packs', 'commands', 'guides', 'all')

conflict_resolution_mode.description: How conflicts were handled: ask=user was prompted, prefer-local=local version kept, prefer-source=source version applied

items.description: Per-item record of every file or resource that was evaluated during sync

item_path.description: File path of the item, relative to repo root

status.description: applied=change was written; skipped=intentionally not applied (see reason); conflict=both versions diverged and could not be auto-resolved; new=item exists only in source and was added; identical=no change needed

reason.description: Explanation for skipped or conflict status — required if status is skipped or conflict

local_version.description: Hash, timestamp, or version identifier of the local version at time of sync

source_version.description: Hash, timestamp, or version identifier of the source version at time of sync

applied_count.description: Total number of items with status=applied

skipped_count.description: Total number of items with status=skipped

conflict_count.description: Total number of items with status=conflict — all must be resolved for sync to be considered complete

compatibility_notes.description: Notes on framework version compatibility, breaking changes encountered, or manual steps required after sync

created_by.description: Agent ID that executed the sync (typically framework-sync-agent)
